get_custom_or_automatic_label_weights: get label weights using custom user values or automatic weighting methods from training data
get_label_weights: get label weights from a user-provided dictionary mapping label names to float weights
get_automatic_label_weights: get automatic label weights using class ratio, sqrt ratio, or capped ratio methods
get_auto_label_weights: get automatic label weights calculated from training data using neg-to-pos class ratio
get_normalized_sqrt_label_weights: get label weights normalized by square root to reduce skew from imbalanced classes
